title: Unauthenticated shared API
mechanism: Any reachable client can read/write/delete supported records; author is a display string.
acceptance: Identity/authorization and negative cross-user tests before public exposure.

title: All-interface launch and raw data beneath webroot
mechanism: Scripts bind 0.0.0.0; static JSON can bypass future API guards. HTTP exposure not exercised here.
acceptance: Default loopback, private data root, denied direct data/lock/temp access, protected media.

title: Remote pull can erase dirty local state
mechanism: Failed push or concurrent local change followed by same-ID remote put marks old data synced.
acceptance: Dirty-record preservation and explicit revision/conflict handling with a stale-pull fixture.

title: Successful sync loses local image references
mechanism: Server attachments replace blobId descriptors; offline renderer cannot find retained bytes.
acceptance: Retain attachment identity and Blob mapping across sync and offline reload.

title: Missing Blob can silently drop attachment
mechanism: Manual push skips absent Blob; transport omits local descriptor, allowing incomplete server record.
acceptance: Missing required media blocks complete-sync status and offers recovery without dropping metadata.

title: Observer reacts to its own marker mutations
mechanism: replaceChildren and append under observed subtree can trigger repeated render work.
acceptance: Owned DOM excluded, idempotent render, bounded refresh; observer-quiescence browser test.

title: Whole-video null time becomes zero
mechanism: Number(null) is finite zero, so bare-video entries qualify as markers/toasts.
acceptance: Explicit null guard; zero-second notes retained; bare-video notes produce neither timed affordance.

title: Capture pacing does not enforce Chrome rate limit
mechanism: 140 ms delay does not guarantee <=2 capture calls/second.
acceptance: Central limiter/backoff and rate-limit failure test, with finally restoration.

title: Screenshot and extracted page may differ
mechanism: Active-window capture versus saved tabId plus live context queries; navigation not pinned.
acceptance: Capture token verifies tab/window/document before and after each stage; mismatch aborts.

title: Failed tile may leave page scrolled and resources retained
mechanism: No finally restores scroll; ImageBitmaps not closed; concurrent capture allowed.
acceptance: Guaranteed cleanup/cancel and one active job per target tab with failure injection.

title: Unscriptable/invalid page can target example.com
mechanism: Fallback is a valid real-looking URL and posting is not disabled.
acceptance: No placeholder target persisted; require explicit valid user target when context unavailable.

title: Draft target/quote can become stale or mismatched
mechanism: Refresh replaces fields but retains body/old nonempty quote; no tab lifecycle subscription.
acceptance: Separate draft from live context, show binding, explicit rebind action and navigation tests.

title: Auto-sync off still permits automatic network paths
mechanism: Reply always POSTs; schema install always POSTs; schema loads always GET.
acceptance: Define network preferences and apply consistently; no unexpected traffic in disabled-mode suite.

title: API trusts structurally invalid record data
mechanism: No full target/key/types/parent/time validation; JSON attachments bypass count checks.
acceptance: Validate typed envelope before mutation, recompute keys, reject malformed shape with stable errors.

title: Untrusted schema kind overrides custom dispatch
mechanism: Supplied metadata spread overrides kind; remote schemas bypass normalizer.
acceptance: Reserved-kind dispatch cannot be selected by custom schemas; all ingress validated.

title: Changing API base does not migrate sync state
mechanism: Synced records skipped on new server; relative media may point to wrong destination.
acceptance: Bind receipts/media to server identity and implement explicit switch/export/import policy.

title: Malformed collection silently becomes empty
mechanism: Next mutation can replace corrupt corpus with a small new array.
acceptance: Fail closed, retain corrupt bytes, explicit repair workflow and corruption tests.

title: Aggregate save is several independent transactions
mechanism: Blobs can orphan; event failure after note commit reports operation failure and invites duplicate.
acceptance: Atomic aggregate where possible; committed-record-aware responses and retry-safe IDs.

title: Blank GPS becomes coordinates 0,0
mechanism: Number empty-string coercion; web additionally omits geographic bounds.
acceptance: Reject blank fields while accepting explicit zero; consistent coordinate/radius validation.

title: Fragment authoring and key parity incomplete
mechanism: Panel loses initial fragment, web always ignores it.
acceptance: Preserve/edit fragment and share semantics with migration compatibility tests.

title: All-query anchor with no pairs matches extra query
mechanism: Early zero-pair return bypasses all-mode length check.
acceptance: All-mode empty set matches only empty live query; duplicate-pair tests retained.

title: YouTube hostname recognition is permissive/inconsistent
mechanism: Substring spoof hosts accepted; web accepts v on unrelated hosts and lacks Shorts support.
acceptance: Strict allowed-host parser shared by both clients; canonical ID validation fixture suite.

title: Schema constraints and scalar conversions differ
mechanism: Required-only validator, permissive unions, numeric enum web strings, missing defaults/ranges.
acceptance: Document/enforce exact supported subset and same typed values across both clients.

title: Context Here can show all data or lag form
mechanism: Invalid target skips filtering; ordinary field edits do not rerender.
acceptance: Invalid-target explicit state and consistent resolver update triggers.

title: Reply status is misleading and validation incomplete
mechanism: Empty message can be stored via bus; ignores sync errors; UI ignores ok false; no event/refresh.
acceptance: Use shared creation service, validate body, return commit/sync result, truthful UI.

title: YouTube navigation and toast lifecycle races
mechanism: Concurrent refreshes can resolve out of order; missing progress can leave toast undefined; stale ID/second state.
acceptance: Generation tokens, clear on navigation, guard unavailable player, detach cleanup.

title: Interactive cards cannot be dismissed reliably
mechanism: No explicit close/outside/Escape; narrow left positioning may be negative.
acceptance: Keyboard/pointer dismiss and viewport-bounded placement tests.

title: Full-page label can hide clipping or extraction loss
mechanism: Dimension clamps, no quality flags; extraction errors default to empty text/HTML.
acceptance: Coverage/truncation/error metadata, explicit partial capture, no false complete label.

title: Memory and screenshot upload budgets differ
mechanism: Potential large canvases/retained tiles, PNG can exceed server 8 MiB.
acceptance: Memory preflight, measured budgets and upload-size outcome without local loss.

title: Rescaling can obscure dimension changes
mechanism: Both entire images distorted into common min rectangle; mixed capture modes accepted.
acceptance: Version algorithm, show dimension/mode changes and compatible comparison policy.

title: No remote snapshot restore or event sync
mechanism: Endpoints exist, corresponding client bridge does not.
acceptance: Label direction accurately; restore requires metadata plus verified media, event purpose decision.

title: No deletion/tombstone reconciliation
mechanism: Remote absence does not delete local record; cached schemas can be republished.
acceptance: Versioned tombstones and explicit conflict/retention semantics before delete UI rollout.

title: Media written before validation and duplicated on retry
mechanism: No transactional rollback/idempotency/GC; extra snapshot files unreferenced.
acceptance: Prevalidate, stage/commit, stable media identity, cleanup and retry tests.

title: No timeouts and incomplete sync summaries
mechanism: Fetch can wait indefinitely; item errors swallowed; stale syncError may remain after success.
acceptance: Abortable network, per-item result ledger, truthful completion and clear resolved errors.

title: Object URLs and stored media accumulate
mechanism: Most object URLs not revoked; no blob/media reference lifecycle or retention.
acceptance: Dispose views, preserve ownership refs, quota/retention design and stress check.

title: No complete backup/import or migrations
mechanism: Export omits binaries/settings; DB remains v1 with no upgrade/recovery protocol.
acceptance: Versioned lossless export/import with hashes and migration fixtures before schema/storage changes.

source: worker lookups; panel feeds; server collections
title: Whole-corpus queries and full-file rewrites
mechanism: Video/recent refresh may pull all notes; loops scan all; HTML/text inflate snapshot JSON.
acceptance: Measure corpus budgets, indexed/delta/paginated queries and bounded concurrency.

source: quick bar open Shadow DOM; auto-sync defaults; image URLs
title: Page and server see sensitive content through intended paths
mechanism: Draft/quote DOM visible to host; no redaction/exclusions; remote image origins unrestricted.
acceptance: Document surface trust, per-origin capture policy and governed remote media loads.

title: Web failure handling/offline behavior weak
mechanism: No durable drafts, several GET status checks absent, submission not locked.
acceptance: Explicit loading/error/retry states and duplicate prevention; offline mode remains separately scoped.

source: panel HTML/CSS; content UIs; web shell
title: Accessibility coverage incomplete
mechanism: Unlabeled images, div-click timeline rows, hidden file inputs, dynamic errors and small text.
acceptance: Keyboard/focus/screen-reader/contrast verification with accessible controls and error links.

title: GPS preference suggests behavior panel does not perform
mechanism: defaultGpsRadius stored but unused in panel resolver; web uses independent server config.
acceptance: Explicit Exact/Nearby mode and clearly scoped setting or remove inactive control.

title: No end-to-end suite, CI, license or pinned development toolchain
mechanism: Only small pure tests; earlier checks are not current runtime proof.
acceptance: Document supported runtimes/distribution decision and required release integration matrix.

title: Identity/time canonicalization can drift or collide
mechanism: LocaleCompare URL sorting, rounded GPS/time keys, arbitrary accepted timestamp formats.
acceptance: Version explicit canonicalization; collision fixtures; normalized timestamps and migration decision.

title: Repeated submit and stale native file selection
mechanism: No full-form submit lock/idempotency; file input value not reset after state clear.
acceptance: One logical submission per action and predictable reselection of same file.

source: panel app.js; web app.js; core built-ins; legacy docs
title: Mixed concerns and compressed duplicated source
mechanism: Large physical lines obscure logic; unused imports/encoder; stale names/overstated reports.
acceptance: Incremental module extraction, format source, remove dead code and maintain generated inventories.
